w: In the morning Swamishri blessed all the sadhus. At 10.00 am Swamishri inaugurated a traffic island named "Swaminarayan Chowk" near the mandir and then visited Ambli Vali Pol. In the evening, from 6.30 pm to 10.30 pm the 50th Anniversary celebration of Swamishri's appointment as President of BAPS was celebrated at the Sardar Patel Stadium. ( See special report )

Swamishri performed the arti of Thakorji on the occasion of Sankari mandir's first patotsav (consecration anniversary). At 10.40 a.m., Swamishri addressed the patotsav assembly of 9,100 devotees and well-wishers.

June 2002 (V.S.2058, Vaishakh vad 12) Friday, Surat. Yogi Jayanti Yogiji Maharaj's 111 th birthday anniversary was celebrated in the presence of 20,000 devotees. The main theme of the celebration was "Dreams Come True". The different wishes and dreams of Yogiji Maharaj for the growth and spread of Akshar and Purushottam were elaborated in a speech by Pujya Narayanmuni Swami. Shri Haka Bapu narrated his experiences about the realization of Yogiji Maharaj's dreams. Then a drama depicted the birth and growth of the children's and youth activities pioneered by Yogiji Maharaj. Pujya Tyagvallabh Swami shared his experiences of Yogiji Maharaj. Pujya Viveksagar Swami spoke about the presence of Yogiji Maharaj today in Pramukh Swami Maharaj. This was followed by a video show based on the kirtan "Jogi ne joya Narayanswarupma re ...". Finally, Swamishri spoke glowingly of Yogiji Maharaj, "Yogiji Maharaj was an extraordinary person. There would be no end in singing his glories if we were to speak of them for hundreds of thousands of years. His life was one of absolute humility, full of saintly virtues and service in all his actions ... ."
After his morning puja in Atladra Swamishri performed the murti-pratishta rituals of canvas murtis for the hari mandir of Maganpura village, sub-district Vaghodiya.

At 9.15 a.m., Swamishri departed from Atladra and arrived in Surat at 11.45 a.m. Swamishri inaugurated the newly built BAPS Students Hostel (chhatralay) and guesthouse. Swamishri then sanctified the hostel and ceremoniously performed the pratishtha rituals of the canvas murtis in the satsang assembly hall for students of the chhatralay.

Sanskruti - cultural program A grand cultural program on India’s glorious heritage ‘Sanskruti’ was performed by 250 BAPS children and youths at the Continental Airlines Arena. A supporting staff of 750 youths managed the coordination and stage arrangements. The audience of 20,000 people savored the spectacular cultural presentation of drama, dance, laser and fireworks.
The 3-hour program was also punctuated with speeches by Viveksagar Swami, Dr Swami and several dignitaries.

Governor of New Jersey, James McGrevy, said, “Namaste. Jai Swaminarayan. Today it is a great honor Swamiji, to be here with you and the Congressmen. It is a great honor to be here in presence of a living spiritual master. To understand the strength of BAPS and to be the beneficiary of his blessings, I first had audience with Swamiji during my trip of Gujarat before becoming the Governor. And as Governor I’m honored at the strength of the Swaminarayan faith here in the State of New Jersey and our region. Swamiji, in New Jersey we have grown to over 5000 families ignited by devotion, by bhakti, by dharma and also detachment. These are the strengths of the Swaminarayan faith of practical spiritualism, eternal purity and adherence to universal truths. And we also understand the importance of seva, performing service for fellow human beings. I as Governor am greatly honored by the contribution that the Indo-American is making to the society. They contribute to science, technology, medicine and also to the great Swaminarayan faith here in USA.” Congressman Stanley Wayer of Washington DC opined, “We have gathered here at a time when many people teach to hate each other, to teach violence, to teach divisions. And as a result of those teachings our world is more divided and violence and terror is visited in India, in United States, in Iraq and in other places in the world. As Governor McGrevy said, it is an honor, privilege and experience to be remembered all through out my life, to be here in the presence of His Divine Holiness. This holy man teaches love and character. He teaches and uplifts, as all of us must do by whatever faith we call. I’m honored to be here with other Congressman. I am honored to see the Akshardham in Delhi that is being built. It will uplift everybody. God blesses America through the visitation of holy men like Pramukh Swami Maharaj.” Co-founder of India Caucus Frank Pallone said, “It is indeed an honor to be here this evening. I was proud to visit the Akshardham in Gandhinagar. Remembered the terrorist attack and remember Swamiji’s appeal of non-violence then. That is one of the most important messages of Swamiji and BAPS that they preach non-violence which is so crucial to today’s society. I also want to pay tribute to many social activities of Swamiji and BAPS. We still remember the work of BAPS when there was earthquake in Gujarat. Also I want to commend the educational commitment of BAPS. I was there last week when they had the youth day and they educate youths with Sanskrit and moral values. This is one of the most important contribution to society - to instill these values in the young generation.” In conclusion, Swamishri blessed the assembly, “You have come here with the culture and values of our country. You may earn and acquire things you require, but, you should also remain resolute in our culture and religion. Old is gold and our Sanatan Dharma has been given to us by God. And God comes again and again to reestablish dharma on earth, God protects our culture and values… Today, because of materialism our faith in God has declined and that is why we are unhappy and without peace…”

A hundred years ago today (5 June 1907) Shastriji Maharaj had performed the murti-pratishtha rituals and arti of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj in Bochasan. To commemorate this memorable occasion a unique function was arranged at 11.00 am. Swamishri’s seat had been designed in the form of a decorative tula. Swamishri presided over the historic small celebration assembly. Viveksagar Swami spoke about the history of BAPS. Then Ishwarcharan Swami addressed the small assembly. Shri Mahendrabhai Barrister expressed their appreciations to Swamishri. After a bhajan Swamishri blessed the assembly, “This Satsang tour has been arranged to celebrate the BAPS Centenary Year, in which hundreds of thousands can experience and avail of the festivity. The celebration has commenced from Africa. Shastriji Maharaj inspired the establishment of Satsang here. The beginning of Satsang and mandirs abroad started from here. So the celebration should be supremely and gloriously celebrated everywhere. It has been prescribed in the shastras that a devotee of God should dedicate his wealth, home and family in the service of God. Dada Khachar and other devotees proved this true. Similarly, this time the devotees of Africa have done this. So there will be peace and that peace shall endure. The reason is he has an understanding of God’s greatness. Whatever we do and achieve is through intelligence which is given by God. Whatever we have has been gifted to us by God.” Swamishri’s blessings concluded at 12.08 pm On this auspicious day Swamishri wrote a letter for all sadhus and devotees: BAPS SANSTHA CENTENARY DAY Date 5.6.2007 Adhik Jeth vad Choth – 4 Mombasa A hundred years ago on this earth Pragat Brahmaswarup Pujya Shastriji Maharaj, for the first time established a shikharbaddh mandir in Bochasan to spread the pure upasana of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, and enshrined Akshar and Purushottam Maharaj in the middle shrine of the mandir. On this holy day may dharma, gnan, vairagya and bhakti be consolidated in your lives and that you also realize Ekantik Dharma. For this, Pragat Brahmaswarup Shastriji Maharaj and Pragat Brahmaswarup Yogiji Maharaj had performed their work with saintliness. So may we all tread on that path and endeavour for the development of Satsang – which will be a great seva. I bless you that you all strive with inner strength. Jai Swaminarayan Shastri Narayanswarupdas
